definitions.beta: OLS covariance(stock,benchmark)/variance(benchmark); same benchmark dates, no missing-price filling
definitions.capture: ratio of geometric mean daily returns on benchmark up/down days; descriptive, not a forecast
definitions.ttm_profit: latest actual 2026 YTD + actual 2025 FY - corresponding actual 2025 YTD; forecasts excluded. Market cap is A-price times all shares, not combined A/H market value.
definitions.cash_proxy: Legacy per-share approximations are retained for audit only, not used in gates or scores. Exact cash and deducted profits fetched from RPT_F10_FINANCE_MAINFINADATA replace them.
definitions.score: 35% quality (TTM margin, exact TTM cash/profit, exact TTM deducted ratio) + 30% sector-relative growth + 20% sector-relative trailing valuation + 15% beta; prioritisation only. Missing exact deducted profit is unknown, not a loss; requires manual verification.
definitions.drawdown: Close-based, adjusted, at most N benchmark trading days. Use observations_N to distinguish shorter listed histories.
definitions.liquidity: Median raw daily volume over 20 days * inferred shares-per-volume-unit * current price; approximate RMB turnover, not exact historical turnover. STAR generally uses shares; other A shares generally lots.
definitions.latest_return: Not used as a gate or score; 20-day run-up is a risk flag only
